tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find events and their markets with live odds. Filter by free-text query, category slug (see predict://categories), sort and status. Each event lists markets with outcomes, token ids, best bid/ask, tick size and a human URL.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full event by slug: every market, outcome names and prices, token ids, tick size, min order size, rules summary, resolution source and status. Optionally include recent trades.

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Live order book for one outcome token: bids and asks (price 0-1, size in shares), spread, midpoint and last trade.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price (probability) history for one outcome token over a range.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Preview an order against the live book without placing it: average and worst price, shares, cost, payout if the outcome wins, Polymarket fee, predictDEX fee and warnings. Market BUY amount is USD to spend all-in; market SELL and limit amounts are shares.

tools.name: get_trading_setup
tools.description: Everything an agent with its own wallet needs to trade: chain, collateral (pUSD), builder code, signer URL, attestation steps, fees and a ready-to-run TypeScript snippet using Polymarket's official SDK. Non-custodial: you sign with your own key.

tools.name: create_trade_link
tools.description: A pre-filled predictDEX ticket URL (event, market, outcome, side, amount) for a person to review and sign in their own wallet. Opening it executes nothing. Use this when you have no wallet or need human confirmation.

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Open positions of a Polymarket trading account or its owner address: size, average price, current price, value and P&L.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Top Polymarket traders by profit or volume over a window.

tools.name: get_agent_challenge
tools.description: Returns the canonical 'predictDEX Agent Attestation v1' message for your address. Sign it with EIP-191 personal_sign within 10 minutes and pass it to attest_agent.

tools.name: attest_agent
tools.description: Submit the signed attestation. Returns a 30-day agent token that unlocks gasless Polymarket account setup through predictDEX's signer for your address only. It grants no custody and no exemption from region rules.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_markets, get_trading_setup, get_agent_challenge · Private data: search_markets, get_event, get_orderbook, get_price_history, get_trading_setup, create_trade_link, attest_agent · Public sink: attest_agent · Destructive: get_trading_setup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_markets, get_trading_setup, get_agent_challenge · Private data: search_markets, get_event, get_orderbook, get_price_history, get_trading_setup, create_trade_link, attest_agent · Public sink: attest_agent · Destructive: get_trading_setup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
